policy: Targets are staged thresholds, not claims of current coverage. Compare against a report from the same component, tool, branch, and build; do not average frontend and backend percentages.

stages.purpose: Freeze a comparable CI measurement before enforcing a new threshold.

backend_java.source: GitHub Actions run 43414310448; JaCoCo; base frozen for review

frontend_typescript.source: GitHub Actions run 43414310448; Karma/Istanbul; base frozen for review

stages.purpose: Raise the measured baseline by five percentage points on critical validation code, then review exceptions before gating.

backend_java.priority: stock, cart quantity, order creation, authorization and input validation

frontend_typescript.priority: registration, login, cart, checkout and error-state handling

stages.purpose: Make the reviewed component threshold a Quality Gate only after the baseline and scope are stable.
stages.gate: enforce-no-regression; ratchet upward by at least five percentage points per agreed release

backend_java.threshold_source: approved same-commit CI baseline plus agreed increment

frontend_typescript.threshold_source: approved same-commit CI baseline plus agreed increment

measured_baseline.environment: GitHub Actions; QA aislado en Docker
measured_baseline.interpretation: La línea es la unidad de código fuente ejecutada por las pruebas; la rama es una alternativa de decisión. Los valores son componente-específicos y usan sus respectivos denominadores JaCoCo/Karma del build 16.

interpretation: La baseline numérica se midió en GitHub Actions build 16. Líneas y ramas no se promedian entre backend y frontend. La siguiente meta de revisión es baseline +5 puntos porcentuales por componente para líneas y ramas críticas; esos incrementos son objetivos de revisión, no gates de aprobación actuales.
